name: obsidian-openui
description: Interactive OpenUI blocks in Obsidian notes, connected across the whole note.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --external:obsidian --external:electron --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=dist/main.js && cat dist/main.css styles.extra.css > dist/styles.css && rm dist/main.css && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.install-vault: npm run build && cp dist/main.js dist/styles.css dist/manifest.json example-vault/.obsidian/plugins/intr/

author: siddhant2408
